_description: Reproducible bugs and footguns in lies.exposed, with diagnosis steps and fixes

_fields.title: string
_fields.area: string — which part of the codebase

title: TypeORM serializes Option wrapper instead of null
symptom: DB column stores {_tag:'None'} or {_tag:'Some',value:...} as JSON instead of null or the actual value
root_cause: OptionFromNullishToNull returns effect/Option, not fp-ts/Option. Calling fp-ts O.toNullable() on it fails silently and TypeORM serializes the wrapper object.
fix: Use O.getOrNull() from 'effect/Option' instead of O.toNullable() from 'fp-ts/Option'
area: packages/@liexp/backend, any TypeORM entity using OptionFromNullishToNull

title: OpenAI structured output fails with optional schema fields
symptom: OpenAI API returns 400 or generates empty/malformed JSON when structured output schema has optional properties
root_cause: OpenAI structured output rejects JSON schemas with optional (non-required) fields. Schema.optional() produces optional JSON schema properties.
fix: Use Schema.NullOr(T) instead of Schema.optional(T). Ensure ALL properties appear in the required array.
area: services/ai-bot, services/agent — any OpenAI structured output schema

title: Agent service loses LocalAI connection after container restart
symptom: Agent returns connection errors after LocalAI container was restarted, even though LocalAI is healthy
root_cause: Docker/K8s DNS caches the old IP of the LocalAI container. Agent resolved it at startup and holds the stale address.
fix: Restart the agent service after restarting LocalAI to force DNS re-resolution.

title: Qwen3 model returns empty content (reasoning mode)
symptom: LangChain chat completions return empty string content from Qwen3 models
root_cause: Qwen3 defaults to thinking mode, putting output in delta.reasoning instead of delta.content. LangChain's @langchain/openai ignores reasoning field.
fix: In LocalAI model yaml: set reasoning.disable: true AND add template prefill '</think>' after '</think>'

title: Storybook type errors after adding new @liexp/ui files
symptom: Storybook type-check fails with 'cannot find module' for newly added UI components
root_cause: Storybook imports from @liexp/ui/lib/... (build output). New source files don't exist in lib/ until rebuilt.
fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @liexp/ui run build' before type-checking storybook after adding new UI files.

title: agent CLI event create silently returns list data instead of created event (http->https redirect demotes POST to GET)
symptom: liexp_cli 'event <type> create' fails with DecodeError: API client decode error, actual data is an array of unrelated pre-existing events (each with score:1) instead of the single created event
root_cause: services/agent/.env or .env.local had API_BASE_URL=http://api.liexp.dev/v1 (or test/AgentEvalTest.ts hardcoded the same). Dev nginx 301-redirects http->https. axios/follow-redirects demotes POST to GET on a 301 by default, dropping the body, so POST /events silently became GET /events and hit ListEventRoute instead of CreateEventRoute.
fix: Always set API_BASE_URL (and MCP_URL) to https://api.liexp.dev/v1 directly in services/agent/.env, .env.local, and test/AgentEvalTest.ts — never rely on the dev nginx redirect for non-GET requests.
area: services/agent (.env, .env.local, test/AgentEvalTest.ts), dev nginx reverse proxy

title: Service-client API tokens 404 on authenticated write routes (id vs userId type confusion)
symptom: liexp_cli mutations (event create/edit etc.) fail with HTTP 500 wrapping AxiosError 404: 'Could not find any entity of type UserEntity matching: {id: <uuid>}', while read-only routes (event list) work fine with the same token
root_cause: scripts/generate-tokens.sh (services/api/src/bin/generate-service-token.ts) signs a ServiceClient-shaped JWT with a fresh random 'id' (client id) and a separate 'userId' (real user reference) — and never touches the DB, so neither id is ever persisted. Write routes like createEvent.controller.ts only call RequestDecoder.decodeUserFromRequest (AuthUser schema: id/email/permissions/iat/exp), which structurally accepts the ServiceClient payload too (effect Schema.Struct ignores the extra userId key) and reads the client's random 'id' as if it were the real user id. UserRepository.findOneOrFail then 404s because no user row has that id. Breaks whenever the dev DB is reseeded (old matching user row disappears) or a fresh token is generated (new random id, no matching user row at all).
fix: Short-term: after running scripts/generate-tokens.sh, manually INSERT a user row in the dev DB whose id equals the token's printed 'ID:' (client id) field, with permissions matching, then use that token as API_TOKEN. Proper fix (deferred): write routes should use RequestDecoder.decodeUserOrServiceClient and look up UserRepository by client.userId, not client.id, so service-client tokens don't need a fake matching user row at all.

title: admin e2e Production-Mode tests 500 under root `pnpm vitest` (two MSW setupServer instances in one fork)
symptom: services/admin/test/admin-server.e2e.test.ts "Production Mode" tests (GET /, /admin/users, nested route) return 500 instead of 200 ONLY when run via root `pnpm vitest` (all projects); the same file passes 13/13 in isolation (cd services/admin && pnpm exec vitest run --project e2e).
root_cause: web-e2e and admin (e2e) vitest projects share ONE fork (both: pool:forks + isolate:false + sequence.groupOrder:2; the poolOptions.forks.singleFork also set then is ignored since Vitest 4 and has been removed). WebAppTest.ts and AdminAppTest.ts each called setupServer(...).listen() on their OWN MSW instance. MSW v2 (@mswjs/interceptors) patches global fetch/http at module scope; a second setupServer stacks interceptors on the first, so requests resolve against the wrong handler set and admin SSR 500s.
fix: Single process-wide setupServer() singleton: packages/@liexp/backend/src/test/msw/sharedServer.ts exports sharedMswServer + registerMswHandlers(...) (idempotent listen once, onUnhandledRequest:warn, handlers appended via .use()). WebAppTest.ts / AdminAppTest.ts call registerMswHandlers(...createApiHandlers()/...createAgentApiHandlers(env)) instead of setupServer().listen(), and no longer call .close(). msw added as @liexp/backend devDependency. Mirrors the pre-existing services/agent/test/mswServer.ts pattern. Rebuild @liexp/backend after editing.
area: packages/@liexp/backend/src/test/msw, services/web/test/WebAppTest.ts, services/admin/test/AdminAppTest.ts, vitest root projects

title: Puppeteer stealth plugin Network.setUserAgentOverride timeout
symptom: ProtocolError: Network.setUserAgentOverride timed out. Occurs during browser.newPage() when puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth tries to apply its user-agent-override evasion via CDP. Worker logs show ~15 min of successful Telegram getUpdates polling before the error.
root_cause: The stealth plugin's onPageCreated hook calls Network.setUserAgentOverride via CDP. When Chrome/Chromium is slow to respond (high load, memory pressure, or container resource limits), the CDP call exceeds the protocolTimeout and throws. puppeteer-core's default protocolTimeout is 30s which is insufficient under load.
fix: Increase protocolTimeout in puppeteer.provider.ts launch options from 30_000ms to 120_000ms. This applies to both browser launch AND newPage() CDP calls. If timeouts persist, also check container CPU/memory limits for the pod running the worker.
area: packages/@liexp/backend/src/providers/puppeteer.provider.ts, services/worker, services/ai-bot, services/agent (all use puppeteer via GetPuppeteerProvider)

title: React-19-only peer dependency crashes React 18 pages with 'X is not a function'
symptom: Production pages render 'APIError (500) — ne is not a function' (minified). Stack ends in React reconciler's ContextConsumer branch (fiber tag 9: children(value)). Nothing reaches Bugsink.
root_cause: A dependency resolved to a React 19-only major (e.g. @mantine/core 9 via @blocknote/mantine peer) renders <Context value> without .Provider. React 18 treats a bare context element as a Consumer and calls its non-function children. Peer resolution can silently jump majors on lockfile regeneration (pnpm v11 migration did this).
fix: Find the component: pause on exceptions via CDP and walk fiber.return from the tag-9 fiber. Pin the dep to a React-18-compatible major as a direct dependency (check its peerDependencies.react in pnpm-lock.yaml). Grep lockfile for peerDependencies 'react: ^19' to spot others.

title: AI entity-update jobs overwrite the wrong actor/group
symptom: After updateEntitiesFromURL jobs, unrelated groups/actors (e.g. WHO, JECFA) have excerpts describing other organisations; one entity edited by many jobs.
root_cause: Flow looked up entities with the fuzzy full-text List query and edited matches[0] blindly, overwriting non-empty excerpts.
fix: Use pickExactMatch (services/ai-bot/src/flows/ai/entityMatching.ts): accept only one unambiguous normalized name match, and only fill empty fields. Never edit the first fuzzy-search hit.

title: Whole AI queue stalls behind one job stuck in 'processing'
symptom: ai-bot logs 'There are jobs already processing' forever; no pending job runs.
root_cause: ai-bot crashed/restarted mid-job, leaving the row in 'processing'; processOpenAIQueue refuses to start any job while one is processing.
fix: processOpenAIQueue now resets jobs processing for longer than STALE_PROCESSING_MS to pending (failed after MAX_JOB_ATTEMPTS); see services/ai-bot/src/services/job-processor/job-retry.ts. Attempts are stored on queue.error.attempts.

title: Failed queue jobs have empty/null error
symptom: queue.error is {} or null on failed jobs, so the cause is unknown.
root_cause: The IOError instance was stored as-is; message/stack are non-enumerable and dropped by JSON serialization.
fix: Store toJobError(e) (services/ai-bot/src/common/error/index.ts), a plain {name,message,status,details,failedAt} object.

title: getStructuredOutput 'schema' must be an Effect Schema, not JSON Schema
symptom: Agent structured-output call fails with 'Agent response does not match the expected schema' or a decode crash.
root_cause: AgentChatService.getStructuredOutput now converts options.schema with JSONSchema.make (sent as output_schema) and decodes the result with it. Passing a raw JSON schema object breaks both steps.
fix: Pass an Effect Schema.Struct (all fields required, Schema.NullOr for unknowns), or omit schema.

title: Service images on liexp-base pnpm-latest have no chromium/ffmpeg
symptom: Puppeteer scrapes fail with "Can't find chrome path" (ai-bot falls back to Wayback); ffmpeg-based thumbnail jobs fail in worker.
root_cause: base.Dockerfile has two targets: `pnpm` (tag *-pnpm-latest, node + pnpm only) and `api-base` (tag *-latest, adds chromium, ffmpeg, cairo libs). Images built FROM *-pnpm-latest lack the system binaries getChromePath() and the ffmpeg provider expect.
fix: Services that use puppeteer or ffmpeg (agent, ai-bot, worker) must build FROM liexp-base:${NODE_VERSION}-latest. Rebuild the base with `scripts/docker/build.sh --base` when bumping pnpm/node.

title: MCP find tools ignored filters: query values must be effect Options with _sort/_order/_start/_end keys
symptom: Agent MCP findGroups/findLinks ignore sort, pagination or ids; results unfiltered
root_cause: fetch*Query reads effect/Option values under _-prefixed keys; plain values or wrong key names are silently dropped
fix: Wrap each field with O.some from effect/Option and use _sort/_order/_start/_end/ids; get-by-id is find* with ids:[uuid]

title: MCP createEvent/editEvent/editGroup silently lost data or crashed: edit queries need Options, create must save
symptom: createEvent returned an event that was never persisted; editEvent payload changes dropped, or crash "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _tag)"; editGroup crash on plain input
root_cause: createEventQuery only builds the entity (caller must ctx.db.save). editEventQuery/editGroup expect effect Options for every optional field (links/media/keywords, base props, payload values); foldOptionals keeps only _tag===Some so plain values are dropped and undefined throws
fix: Wrap every optional edit field with O.some/O.fromNullable (O.none() when absent); save after createEventQuery. See services/api/src/routes/mcp/tools/eventPayload.ts (pure, unit-tested) and mcpToolsCRUD.e2e.ts

title: pre-push hook failed on agent VMs without docker
symptom: git push aborted: docker compose up / healthcheck fails or port 8432 refused
root_cause: hook unconditionally started db-test and the docker app stack
fix: scripts/ensure-test-db.sh only starts the DB via docker when 127.0.0.1:8432 is unreachable and docker works, else warns; app healthcheck is opt-in (PREPUSH_HEALTHCHECK=1); post-push stop is guarded. Without docker, provide Postgres on 8432 yourself or e2e tests fail

title: Agent chat fails with MCP "Server not initialized" after API deploy
symptom: Admin chat errors; agent logs: Failed to load tools from server api ... Bad Request: Server not initialized (-32000)
root_cause: API /mcp kept StreamableHTTP sessions in process memory; API restart invalidated the agent long-lived mcp-session-id (also breaks with >1 API replica)
fix: /mcp is now stateless (new server+transport per POST, sessionIdGenerator undefined, GET/DELETE 405, session header ignored). Old API: kubectl rollout restart deploy/agent -n prod

title: Agent e2e tests run stale code: #flows/* imports resolve to build/
symptom: Agent e2e/CLI tests ignore edits to src/flows or src/routes (e.g. a new function signature is not called, old behaviour returned) while spec tests pass.
root_cause: services/agent/package.json 'imports' maps #flows/*, #routes/*, #context/* etc. to ./build/*; vitest resolves those through package imports, so the compiled build/ output is what runs.
fix: Run 'pnpm --filter agent run build' (tsc -b tsconfig.build.json) before 'pnpm --filter agent test:e2e'.

title: ai-bot CrashLoopBackOff: "Can't parse configuration" after release
symptom: ai-bot exits 1 about a second after start with [DecodeError] Can't parse configuration, AIBotConfig key is missing.
root_cause: A key added to AIBotConfig as required was not added to the Helm ConfigMap (and compose/local config files), which are maintained separately from the schema.
fix: Make new config keys Schema.optional, or update helm/templates/services/ai-bot/ai-bot.configmap.yaml in the same PR. services/ai-bot/src/__tests__/config.spec.ts decodes the Helm config against the schema.

title: admin/web e2e flake: ENOTEMPTY renaming Vite deps_temp to deps
symptom: One e2e suite fails in beforeAll with ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rename '.../node_modules/.vite-test/deps_temp_*' -> '.../deps'.
root_cause: E2E files run in parallel, each starting a Vite dev server on one shared cacheDir that testSetup also deletes. The poolOptions.forks.singleFork setting seeming to serialise them was outside `test` and removed in Vitest 4, so it did nothing (since deleted from the configs).
fix: One cache dir per worker: suffix .vite-test with VITEST_POOL_ID in both createApp and test/testSetup.ts.

title: Failed to resolve import "@blocknote/core" in tests that still pass
symptom: admin spec output shows Failed to resolve import "@blocknote/core..." from @liexp/ui lib files, caught by a React error boundary.
root_cause: vitest.base-config aliased @blocknote/core to a mock using a path that resolved to lib/test/lib/test/mocks (nonexistent). String aliases also match subpaths. The sharp, canvas, pdfjs and `@liexp/*/lib/**` aliases there were broken or never matched (glob keys).
fix: The whole base alias block was removed. For a new alias, build the path from import.meta.url of the base config (./mocks/x.mock.js), verify it exists, and do not use globs in string keys.
